mapper.select: SELECT b.*, m.name AS member_name, c.name AS course_name, co.name AS coach_name FROM booking b LEFT JOIN member m ON b.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN course c ON b.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN coach co ON c.coach_id = co.id ORDER BY b.create_time DESC
